name: host-dir
description: Converge a directory on the host running apply — mode enforced past the umask, owner set through `sudo chown`, and every state the path can be found in told apart rather than assumed
instructions: Host-converging module: apply creates the directory on the machine running apply. Reaches the machine through `../host-exec`, installed with it. `path` must be absolute and holds only [A-Za-z0-9/._-], because it is interpolated into `stat` and `chown`. `mode` is a four-digit octal string ('0755', not '755') and is chmod'ed after creation, since mkdir's mode argument is masked by the umask. Setting `owner` needs passwordless sudo for chown. No `destroy` on purpose: removing a declared directory would delete its contents, which is a human act.
